nodes.label: No automatic role/channel creation (except clans)
nodes.rationale: Admins designate their own roles and channels in /option and /config; the only exception is clans, whose private channel and 'Clan - Nom' role are created and deleted with the clan.

nodes.label: Three Bots in One Project (main, temporaire, modmail)
nodes.norm_label: three bots in one project (main, temporaire, modmail)
nodes.rationale: bot.py launches up to three Discord bots, each with its own token and cog list from config.py; running without --bot starts all three and exits if any token is missing, so --bot main is recommended when only the main bot is used.

nodes.label: Token security (tokens only in .env)
nodes.rationale: Tokens pasted in .md/.py files get pushed to GitHub; .gitignore excludes .env and data/*.json; leaked tokens must be reset in the Developer Portal.
